STANDALONE STOCK JAGUAR · NATIVE INTEGRATION · 2026-10-17

More of HexGL.
On stock Jaguar.

Inertial steering and cross-slope banking. Actual chase/orbit/near cameras and bank tracking. Original-font race messages and real gameplay settings, with native replay, source assets and local saved records.

Expanded native port — not exact or complete source parity. This build implements banked source sky, actual source-ship contact shadow, blue scene-face material selection, real native scene convolution/bloom, original particle color/lifetime response and native AV/DSP controls. The 23-file application audit records every native/platform/network disposition without claiming line/function equivalence. Source angular/chase-up response, per-fragment shader/shadow-map fidelity, full emitter/booster behavior, RGB/high-resolution bloom, HRTF/gain fidelity and complete browser presentation remain limitations. Physical Jaguar hardware remains untested. Online services are excluded by the agreed standalone-stock target.
All ten current-ROM suites passed: 17 core scenarios, 7 stock desktop scenarios, 2 focused HUD runs, 10 front-end/replay/save scenarios, 4 focused dynamics/effects scenarios, 2 material/sky/stereo scenarios, 4 dedicated falling/pause scenarios, 2 original-stereo/event scenarios, 10 gameplay-feature scenarios, 6 expanded native-system scenarios and 148 unit tests. Fault controls were rejected; all reports match this ROM hash.

New: remaining native visual and AV systems

  • Real banked panorama with fractional A1-source X/Y stepping, bounded rotated extent and actual seam splitting.
  • Moving contact shadow from all 1,676 original Feisar faces, projected through the real yaw/pitch/bank/aspect camera onto the original height-map surface.
  • Actual near-stern scene triangles rasterized with source-derived blue-light textures; independently switchable, separate from exhaust art.
  • Scene bloom after particles: 48×25 intermediate samples, separable five-tap convolution and two signed-safe saturated intensity-add blits per 8×8 cell, approximately 0.8 strength. Genuine convolution/addition, not a relabeled sprite. CrY/lower-resolution/tap-count limits are explicit; bloom/shadow default off for performance.
  • Actual per-particle original color2 ranges, bounded 10-spark/5-cloud collision mix, and source half-life brightness rather than cloud-alpha fading.
  • AV SETTINGS page and keys 6/7/8/9/0 for bloom/contact shadow/blue light/music/SFX. Independent DSP bus mute keeps original decoders running; both muted produces actual silent I2S PCM.
  • Reproducible source-file/SHA inventory covers 23 application JavaScript files; native, offline, platform and agreed networking exclusions are explicit.

See docs/REMAINING-NATIVE-SYSTEMS.md, docs/source-inventory.json and docs/remaining-additional-checks.json. Native blur/projection/source-mask/blitter operands, actual screenshot pixels, real audio consumers and power-on diagnostics have independent checks. This does not erase the remaining fidelity work.

Retained handling, views and race flow

  • Bounded Q8 yaw inertia and signed fractional heading integration, normalized for PAL/NTSC, with direct steering as a real option.
  • Original-map bilinear side probes drive actual cross-slope mesh banking, composed with steering/airbrake bank.
  • Actual CHASE/ORBIT/NEAR camera placement and optional filtered camera bank. Vertices, normals, particles, glow and scene light use the real camera transform; the panorama now follows pitch/yaw/bank.
  • Six extra signed words per actual-run replay sample retain camera XYZ/yaw/roll and composed bank, with independent playback interpolation.
  • Original Bebas Neue countdown, GO/lap/boost/impact/low-shield/pause banners and active-time slide-in feedback.
  • Five real native gameplay settings: view, bank, HUD, particles/glow and inertial steering. Menu/keypad input; settings survive Option in RAM, not power-off.
  • Manual and assisted boost expire against the active race clock: 90 NTSC or 75 PAL fields. The old assisted latch is removed.

docs/GAMEPLAY-HANDLING-VIEWS.md documents controls, source mapping, native arithmetic, test coherency and remaining gaps. Current observed-state message/boost proof is in docs/gameplay-additional-checks.json.

Retained perspective particles and original stereo

  • Perspective-sized source sprite resampling and individual viewport clipping, with native RGB additive sparks/glow and alpha-over clouds.
  • Actual ship-motion velocity inheritance at approximately .7, retained bounded world-space lifetimes and pause.
  • Center-depth queries use real submitted triangle coordinates and vertex Z. A separate native GPU diagnostic ROM tests 12 query cases, including three real rejection results. Driving traces verify depth math, not observed occlusion events.
  • All five full-duration original left/right sources fit the original one-MiB audio slot as stereo IMA4; the DSP independently decodes both channels and retains source content.
  • Source-texel, alpha, RGB, perspective-size, actual TOM pixel, native triangle depth, and exact DSP-source sample proofs.

docs/PARTICLES-AND-ORIGINAL-STEREO.md documents source mapping, compressed-audio quality, memory, fixtures and remaining compromises. This is not per-fragment WebGL, HRTF, or full physics parity.

Retained material and sky integration

  • Original normal/specular maps and six-face sky reflections converted to eight camera-dependent native material banks.
  • Actual scene-triangle sun visibility baked into face luminance, plus real booster-local scene-face illumination.
  • Zero-key ordered-alpha booster, double-sided banner and source-blue speed material.
  • Camera pitch, yaw and bank drive the original tall panorama, with fractional source blits split at its seam.
  • Original-channel music/destruction without movement panning and spatially balanced wind/boost/collision, with distinct signed-saturating left/right I2S output.
  • Fixed falling displacement at longer frame steps; multiplication operands now respect Jaguar low-16-bit arithmetic.

These are hardware adaptations, not shader/WebAudio equivalence. See docs/MATERIALS-SKY-AND-STEREO.md for source hashes, algorithms, memory layout and remaining fidelity gaps.

Retained native dynamics

  • Actual lateral airbrake drift and decaying map-derived contact impulses.
  • Bilinear height-map hover, active-time falling/destruction and filtered terrain pitch on the original ship and booster meshes.
  • Vertical chase look-at rotation of real rendered vertices and normals. An independent oracle checks actual GPU-transformed and projected ship vertices.
  • Original spark/cloud textures in real world-space collision emitters: a bounded 16-slot pool, one-second lifetimes, fading and pause.
  • Original stern booster glow sprite controlled by speed and boost. The sprite is separate from the new coarse scene-face light; neither is mislabeled as bloom; the separate post-scene convolution module implements bloom.
  • Ship/camera pitch stored and interpolated in actual-run replay.

Detailed source mapping, hardware adaptations and limits: docs/DYNAMICS-AND-EFFECTS.md. Particle rendering uses perspective-resampled source art, native RGB additive/alpha-over and a conservative center-depth policy, not a full WebGL pipeline. The sky is genuinely bank-resampled, but remains a cylindrical panorama, not a full cubemap.

Retained systems

  • Original bg.jpg, title.png and Bebas Neue font: native Start, Controls, Local Records, Credits, Replay, Game Settings and result presentation.
  • Controller-only menu navigation. A confirms; Up/Down select; Option returns to Start. Browser layout/settings/transitions are adapted, not reproduced exactly.
  • Genuine native run sampling and elapsed-field interpolation of position, heading, bank and camera. Pause, end hold and Option exit work; replay cannot save a score.
  • Real cartridge EEPROM serial transactions with two-slot journals, checksum/version validation, readback and bounded waits. Manual and autopilot best times remain separate.
  • Existing source-art gauges, countdown, split timing, ship/camera filters and black-screen gates retained.

Actual emulator captures

These are actual Virtual Jaguar output, not illustrative mockups. The menu art is converted from original files. Playback drives the real native mesh/camera; it does not play a video or the supplied static upstream replay.

Persistence proof

A complete native three-lap race wrote and verified nine EEPROM words. A separate emulator process reopened the same CRC-named cartridge EEPROM file and visibly displayed the same saved value. NTSC evidence: total 254000 ms, best lap 84366 ms. PAL is independently tested with field-normalized milliseconds. Replay/menu navigation performs no score writes.

Additional EEPROM-format fault fixtures verify checksum rejection, incomplete-commit fallback, generation wrap and blank storage. They are fault-test inputs, not fabricated race evidence. No host tool patches game RAM.

Replay limits

The last run lives in RAM: 6,144 samples × 64 bytes, two recorded pitch bytes and six actual-camera/bank words per sample. The added 144 KiB camera buffer is below the triangle-depth arena, guarded against the loaded program. A new countdown replaces it; power-off loses it. A full buffer safely retains a playable prefix. Actual native chase/orbit/near coordinates, yaw, roll and composed bank are reproduced, not original THREE.js quaternion behavior. This is bounded native replay, not unlimited persistent recording.

Clean rebuild

docs/dynamics-clean-rebuild.json and its build log document a separate fresh source build with full material/geometry/sky/audio regeneration producing an identical ROM, with additional NTSC/PAL boot, HUD, physics and actual-vertex checks.

Build and play

make assets    # regenerate all original asset groups
make rom       # GPU/DSP/68000 build + cartridge checks
make test      # all native/core/UI/save/replay and stock GUI gates
make release   # gate, current report and source/ROM archive
virtualjaguar rom/hexgl.j64 --ntsc --gpu --dsp

In a race: A/Up thrust, Left/Right steer, B/Down brake, C autopilot, Pause hold, Option reset/menu. Keypad 1 cycles views, 2 camera bank, 3 HUD, 4 particles/glow, 5 inertial/direct steering; 6 bloom, 7 contact shadow, 8 blue light, 9 music and 0 effects. Star switches settings pages. Stock keyboard defaults include L=A, J=C, Z/C=steering, K=B, P=Pause, O=Option; S/X = menu Up/Down and L confirms (or use your configured controller).
